content:
nora: Quick sync on compare UX: folks keep getting surprised when compare doesn’t reflect new filters. We discussed snapshot vs live earlier but need a clear affordance. Thoughts?

ken: I think persistent snapshot is fine but we need to show it clearly. Idea: show a subtle badge in the compare header: "Snapshot • catalog filters at open" with a lighter background + a small \u21bb resync icon that opens a menu.

ash: +1 for explicit affordance. Implementation-wise we can add a resync button that updates the compare results. Should it be destructive (replace pinned models) or only refresh filter chips?

riley: From usability tests, people expect resync to re-run the filter constraint and update which models are shown, but NOT change pinned selections automatically. They were upset when their compare view replaced model rows.

pat: Technically easier to re-evaluate visible rows and mark any newly filtered-in models as "new" (small badge) and leave pinned rows as-is. That avoids deleting user selection.

ken: Visuals: header state variants: live (green dot + text "Live"), snapshot (gray badge "Snapshot at 11:12"), and stale (amber "Filters changed" with "Resync" CTA). Need clear contrast for these pills—current amber on light background fails contrast at 12px.

ash: We should update token set: use colors catalog.badge.success-600, warning-700 etc. And use semibold text for pill copy. Also ensure pill has 4px padding and 12px min-height for touch.

nora: Copy decision: "Resync" vs "Refresh" vs "Apply catalog filters". Which is clearest?

riley: Participants in study preferred short verbs: "Sync" or "Resync". "Apply" confused some who thought it would change their pinned choices.

ken: UX proposal: show small pill: "Snapshot" + subtitle (hover): "This compare reflects filters from when you opened it. Click Resync to apply current catalog filters (will not unpin models)." Resync opens a confirmation toast: "Updated compare — 2 new models added" with an UNDO action.

pat: Backend note: resync will need an endpoint to re-run filter query without mutating pinset. That exists as GET /compare?pins=[ids]&filters=current. We should throttle to avoid multiple rapid refreshes.

ash: Accessibility: resync button must be keyboard reachable, have aria-live updates for number of models changed, and confirmation dialog should be accessible. Also add aria-describedby pointing to the pill help text.

ken: Badges: performance badge styling is flagged again. On small view (10px label) contrast is low. Options: increase pill background darkness or move metric text to 13px and keep pill. Pref to increase text size rather than darken token.

pat: Increasing text size affects layout — may break tight catalogue rows. Alternative: keep 10px but add 1px stroke to text to improve legibility. Need QA across browsers.

nora: Decision list for next sprint: 1) Add Snapshot/Resync affordance in compare header (Resync leaves pins intact). 2) Use semibold pills + updated color tokens for accessible contrast. 3) Resync action shows toast with undo. 4) Accessibility: aria-live for changes + keyboard focus order. 5) Update copy: use "Resync" and "Pin version" for version control.

design-bot: created design issue: D-1265 compare resync affordance + badge contrast.

ash: I'll mock interactive prototype and include keyboard flow. pinging for design review Thursday. :eyes:

ken: I'll update Figma states (live/snapshot/stale) and add hover copy.

nora: Great. Assign owners in the ticket and include small perf badge tests. Thanks all.
